schema: rumpy-harness M9 training table (PR-024; ACCEPTANCE C5 / C6 / C12 denominator)
layout: <set>/<target>/<day>.parquet — one file per UTC day and target, flat (no hive `day=` key: every loaded column is in the file and in rux-ml's data_hash); a day with no written row writes no file (listed in the manifest with rows 0)
rows_written: every row of the formula except the censored ones (counted, never written); a row whose order could not be placed (no_book, below_one_lot) or rests nowhere (alo_expired) IS written with its y__outcome and null targets, so the per-day count is the formula minus the censored rows exactly — a consumer filters on its target's non-null (rux-ml `row_filter_non_null`)
point_in_time: every feat__ value at stamp t reads only l2 / tape / ctx rows stamped in (t - 3660000, t]; l2 at the first row per (coin, stamp // 10000); no port-derived column (M1 / M3 are oracle / null in v0.3, A8)

fill_checkpoints_ms.source: the markout horizons shorter than the order horizon, then the order horizon (labels.build)

reach_ms.source: entry + order horizon + the longest markout (A3)

fill.rows_per_day: N coins x label stamps x 2 sides x |p| x |Q| - censored (counted)

y.name: y__outcome
y.definition: the order's outcome code (`outcomes`); a censored row is never written

y.name: y__fill_frac_h60000
y.definition: filled lots / the order's lots by the arrival + 60000 ms — the venue's fill rule at the pinned fork (A1); null unless y__outcome is ok

y.name: y__fill_frac_h600000
y.definition: filled lots / the order's lots by the arrival + 600000 ms — the venue's fill rule at the pinned fork (A1); null unless y__outcome is ok

y.name: y__fill_frac_h3600000
y.definition: filled lots / the order's lots by the arrival + 3600000 ms — the venue's fill rule at the pinned fork (A1); null unless y__outcome is ok

y.name: y__fill_frac
y.definition: filled lots / the order's lots by the arrival + 14400000 ms — the venue's fill rule at the pinned fork (A1); THE fill label (the order's resting horizon; the EV's target, D45 #3); null unless y__outcome is ok

y.name: y__markout_bp_h60000
y.definition: the markout 60000 ms after each fill, share-weighted over the fills: -side * (mid(tau + h) - mid(tau)) / mid(tau) * 1e4 bp, adverse positive, mid from the 10 s bucket <= the time; null when unfilled (A9)

y.name: y__markout_bp_h600000
y.definition: the markout 600000 ms after each fill, share-weighted over the fills: -side * (mid(tau + h) - mid(tau)) / mid(tau) * 1e4 bp, adverse positive, mid from the 10 s bucket <= the time; null when unfilled (A9)

y.name: y__markout_bp_h3600000
y.definition: the markout 3600000 ms after each fill, share-weighted over the fills: -side * (mid(tau + h) - mid(tau)) / mid(tau) * 1e4 bp, adverse positive, mid from the 10 s bucket <= the time; null when unfilled (A9)

y.name: y__markout_bp
y.definition: the markout 14400000 ms after each fill, share-weighted over the fills: -side * (mid(tau + h) - mid(tau)) / mid(tau) * 1e4 bp, adverse positive, mid from the 10 s bucket <= the time; null when unfilled (A9); the EV's target at the decision interval (D45 #3)

y.name: y__capture_bp
y.definition: the half-spread capture side * (mid(tau) - px) / mid(tau) * 1e4, share-weighted over the fills, reported apart from the markout; null when unfilled

y.name: y__ttf_first_ms
y.definition: ms from t to the first fill; -1 when none

y.name: y__ttf_full_ms
y.definition: ms from t to the fill completing the order's lots; -1 when none

y.name: y__queue_ahead_at_ack
y.definition: the queue ahead (coins) when the exchange acks the order at t + L — a label-side value (it reads t + L), never a feature

y.name: y__through
y.definition: a print through the price, or the opposite best reaching it, filled every leaf

feat.name: feat__spread_bp
feat.definition: (ask - bid) / mid * 1e4 at the latest bucketed l2 row

feat.name: feat__book_age_ms
feat.definition: t - the latest bucketed l2 row's stamp (the book's staleness)

feat.name: feat__near_l1_usd
feat.definition: level-0 USD on the row's own book side (the bid for a buy)

feat.name: feat__opp_l1_usd
feat.definition: level-0 USD on the other book side

feat.name: feat__near_depth_usd_10bp
feat.definition: displayed USD on the row's own side within 10 bp of the mid

feat.name: feat__near_depth_usd_30bp
feat.definition: displayed USD on the row's own side within 30 bp of the mid

feat.name: feat__opp_depth_usd_10bp
feat.definition: displayed USD on the other side within 10 bp of the mid

feat.name: feat__opp_depth_usd_30bp
feat.definition: displayed USD on the other side within 30 bp of the mid

feat.name: feat__qi_l1
feat.definition: (near l1 - opp l1) / (near l1 + opp l1), level-0 USD (Gould & Bonart)

feat.name: feat__near_walk_bp_q1000
feat.definition: a taker on the row's side consuming $1000 of the FAR side's displayed levels at t: side * (vwap - the far touch) / mid * 1e4 (positive cost); null when the displayed book holds less

feat.name: feat__near_walk_bp_q3000
feat.definition: a taker on the row's side consuming $3000 of the FAR side's displayed levels at t: side * (vwap - the far touch) / mid * 1e4 (positive cost); null when the displayed book holds less

feat.name: feat__top_age_ms
feat.definition: t - the first bucketed row of the current run of an unchanged near best price (censored at the lookback)

feat.name: feat__ofi_60s
feat.definition: side * the sum of Cont-Kukanov-Stoikov e_n over bucketed-row transitions in the window (level-0 USD; null when no transition)

feat.name: feat__ofi_300s
feat.definition: side * the sum of Cont-Kukanov-Stoikov e_n over bucketed-row transitions in the window (level-0 USD; null when no transition)

feat.name: feat__rv_bp_300s
feat.definition: sqrt(sum of squared simple mid returns between consecutive bucketed rows in the window) * 1e4; null when no pair

feat.name: feat__rv_bp_3600s
feat.definition: sqrt(sum of squared simple mid returns between consecutive bucketed rows in the window) * 1e4; null when no pair

feat.name: feat__ret_bp_60s
feat.definition: side * (mid(t) / mid(the last bucketed row <= t - w) - 1) * 1e4

feat.name: feat__ret_bp_300s
feat.definition: side * (mid(t) / mid(the last bucketed row <= t - w) - 1) * 1e4

feat.name: feat__ret_bp_3600s
feat.definition: side * (mid(t) / mid(the last bucketed row <= t - w) - 1) * 1e4

feat.name: feat__trade_n_60s
feat.definition: prints stamped in (t - w, t]

feat.name: feat__trade_n_300s
feat.definition: prints stamped in (t - w, t]

feat.name: feat__same_vol_usd_300s
feat.definition: taker notional px * sz of prints in the window initiated on the row's side

feat.name: feat__opp_vol_usd_300s
feat.definition: taker notional px * sz of prints in the window initiated on the other side

feat.name: feat__trade_gap_ms_300s
feat.definition: min(t - the last print's stamp, w); w when none

feat.name: feat__funding_rate
feat.definition: side * the latest ctx funding rate: positive = the row's side pays

feat.name: feat__oi_chg_3600s
feat.definition: (open interest(t) / open interest(the last ctx row <= t - w) - 1) * 1e4

feat.name: feat__ctx_age_ms
feat.definition: t - the latest ctx row's stamp (K12: a carried ctx value stays visible; rows above ctx_age_max_ms are counted)

feat.name: feat__queue_ahead_usd
feat.definition: displayed USD on the row's own side at the order's own price (the policy's hl_price rule from the latest bucketed touch at t, offset p); 0 between displayed levels; null beyond the deepest

walk.rows_per_day: N coins x label stamps x 2 sides x |Q| - censored (counted)

y.name: y__outcome
y.definition: the IOC's outcome code (`outcomes`); a censored row is never written

y.name: y__walk_bp
y.definition: the pure impact of the filled part: side * (vwap - touch) / mid * 1e4 at the arrival t + L, the venue's IOC walk to the policy's limit (A14); the EV's target (D45 #3); null unless y__outcome is ok and a lot filled

y.name: y__walk_filled_frac
y.definition: the filled part of Q; the IOC expires the rest

y.name: y__half_spread_bp
y.definition: (ask - bid) / 2 / mid * 1e4 at the arrival (the spread term, apart from the impact)

y.name: y__censored_beyond_book
y.definition: 1 when Q outlasts the displayed levels inside the limit

y.name: y__levels_walked
y.definition: price levels the IOC consumed
